findings.message: The CRD aiservices.hub.traefik.io under crds/ changed (the file contents changed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.

The CRD managedapplications.hub.traefik.io under crds/ changed (the file is new). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.

The CRD managedsubscriptions.hub.traefik.io under crds/ changed (the file contents changed). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
The pod template of Deployment/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-traefik changed at spec.template.metadata.labels.helm.sh/chart. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.
